questions.q: The second book is ___ as exciting as the first one. I almost stopped reading.
questions.why: «Далеко не такий» — *nowhere near as … as*. *not near*, *nowhere nearly*, *no near* — неправильні вирази (правильно ще *not nearly*).

questions.q: Their new house is ___ big as their old one — it has eight bedrooms!
questions.why: У скільки разів — *twice as big as*. *twice big* — бракує *as*; *two times more as* — змішані конструкції; *double as* — неграматично.

questions.q: This laptop is ___ faster than my old one.
questions.why: Підсилення порівняльного ступеня — *far faster*. *very faster* — помилка; *too faster* і *so faster* — неграматично.

questions.q: She is ___ the best student in the class.
questions.why: Підсилення найвищого ступеня — *by far the best*. *far the best* без *by* — неграматично; *much more the best* і *very the best* — неграматично.

questions.q: It wasn't so much a meeting ___ a friendly chat.
questions.why: *not so much X as Y* — «не стільки…, скільки…». *than*, *like*, *that* у цій конструкції не вживають.

questions.q: Of the two candidates, Maria is ___.
questions.why: Із двох — *the* + порівняльний: *the better qualified*. *the best* — із трьох і більше; *better qualified than* — бракує другого члена; *most qualified* — найвищий ступінь без *the*.
У питанні з порівняльним — *any better*. *some better*, *more better*, *very better* — неграматично.

questions.q: He's ___ a manager than an engineer these days.
questions.why: «Скоріше» — *more of a … than*. *more a manager* — без *of* неприродно; *most of* і *much of* — неграматично тут.

questions.q: The new version is no ___ than the old one, so don't buy it.
questions.why: *no better than* — «не краще, ніж». *no good than*, *no best than*, *no more good than* — неграматично.

questions.q: It's getting ___ to find a cheap flat in the city.
questions.why: Зміна з часом — *harder and harder*. *hard and harder* і *more hard and hard* — неправильні форми; *the harder* — потребує другої частини *the …*.

questions.q: The test was ___ easier than I expected — I finished in ten minutes.
questions.why: Підсилення порівняльного — *considerably easier*. *very easier* — помилка; *too much easier* — неприродно; *so easier* — неграматично.

questions.q: It's ___ like as cold as it was last winter.
questions.why: *nothing like as … as* — «зовсім не такий». *not like as*, *nowhere like as*, *none like as* — неграматично.

questions.q: This hotel costs half ___ much as the one in the centre.
If you can come early, all the ___.
Prices are slightly ___ (high) this year than last year.

answer: The film was nowhere near as good as the book
questions.why: *nowhere near as … as* — далеко не такий.

answer: Our flat is twice as big as theirs
questions.why: У скільки разів — *twice as big as*.
